name: Shippie
description: Code review agent that reads a diff, explores the surrounding codebase with tools and posts comments on the pull request.
whatItDoes: Shippie reviews changes like a human reviewer would, looking beyond the diff to see how the change fits the project. It is typically run in CI and writes its findings to the pull request. Developers can also run it locally.
howItWorks: The reviewer is an agent loop built on the flue and Pi libraries. It has tools for reading files and searching the repository, and extra tools can be attached through MCP. Model credentials and the GitHub token are supplied as environment variables.

requirements.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
requirements.description: Model key; OPENAI_API_KEY or OPENROUTER_API_KEY can be used instead

requirements.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
requirements.description: Needed to post review comments in CI

requirements.name: Node.js
requirements.description: The tool is run with npx

models: Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Cloudflare Workers AI
